ModMetaData.name: No Max Bills: Redux
ModMetaData.author: "Just Harry"
ModMetaData.description:
Workbenches, in the UI, are limited to no-more-than fifteen bills each; this mod removes that limit.
This is a recreation of KiameV's "No Max Bills" mod, which can be found at https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1588831229.
The source-code for this mod can be found at https://github.com/just-harry/no-max-bills-redux-for-rimworld.
